about.title: A hybrid profile: product, code and security.
about.lead: I'm Jorge Campo, a full stack developer and pentester. I'm just as comfortable in React and Node as I am in a Linux shell, always balancing user experience, performance and attack surface.
about.body: My approach is simple: understand the problem, design a maintainable solution, and test it as if I were the attacker. That lets me build products that don't just work — they hold up.
about.focus1Desc: React interfaces, Node and FastAPI APIs, and data in MongoDB, MySQL or SQLite.
about.focus2Desc: Web pentesting, privilege escalation and Active Directory environments. eJPT and eCPPT.
about.focus3Desc: Real-time telemetry, GPU metrics, tokens and energy cost for local models.
about.stackDesc: Tools I use to take an idea from the first commit to production.

featured.heading: Local AI, under control.
featured.headingDesc: A project born from a real need: understanding what happens inside my server while a model is generating.
featured.subtitle: The dashboard that turns local inference into actionable data.
featured.description: Monitor IA is a real-time dashboard for models running on your own server. It tracks tokens, context usage, GPU/VRAM, temperature, power and energy cost, and adds server security and cooling. FastAPI backend with WebSocket, React frontend and a native SwiftUI app.
featured.bullet1: Live WebSocket streaming with SQLite history and CSV export.
featured.bullet2: OpenAI-compatible proxy that captures tokens, context and cost per request.
featured.bullet3: Server security: SSH, firewall, web scans and geolocation.
featured.bullet4: Cooling with fan profiles and an iOS app built with Swift Charts.

projects.title: Other things I've built.
projects.description: Full stack applications, APIs and security tools. Each one solves a different problem and shares the same obsession with detail.
projects.memeDesc: A meme-based social network for developers: sign-up, login, posts and likes. React and Redux interfaces on top of a custom API.
projects.memeApiDesc: REST API for the social network, documented with Swagger. Authentication, posts, comments and likes with Node, Express and MongoDB.
projects.shopDesc: A complete e-commerce experience with catalogue, authentication, cart and orders. React/Redux frontend connected to a store API.
projects.shopApiDesc: REST API for e-commerce with products, users, orders and Stripe payments. Node, Express and Sequelize.
projects.triviaDesc: A 10-question SPA that consumes an external API, with instant right/wrong feedback. Vanilla JavaScript.
projects.blogDesc: Personal blog with HackTheBox and VulnHub writeups, news and pentesting and cybersecurity techniques.
